program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const isReleased = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isReleased ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropVelocity = -gravity * dropTime; const dropAcceleration = isReleased ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isReleased ? tossedHeight : apexHeight; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 35, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Toss lane", state: t < apexTime * 0.2 ? "At launch" : t < apexTime * 0.9 ? "Rising" : t <= apexTime * 1.1 ? "At the top" : t < apexTime * 1.8 ? "Falling" : "At launch height", id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 340, y: 35, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Drop lane", state: !isReleased ? "Held in place" : t < apexTime * 1.1 ? "Just released" : t < apexTime * 1.8 ? "Falling together" : "At launch height", id: "lane.drop" })); const heightScale = 120; const baseY = 350; const tossedY = baseY - (tossedHeight / 2.2) * heightScale; const dropY = baseY - (dropHeight / 2.2) * heightScale; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 170, tossedY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", 470, dropY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: 140, y: tossedY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: 200, y: tossedY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: 440, y: dropY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: 500, y: dropY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); const apexY = baseY - (apexHeight / 2.2) * heightScale; objects.push(sdk.gate("gate", 470, apexY, { open: isReleased, label: "Apex gate" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(75, 50, [`v: ${sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2)} m/s`, `a: ${sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1)} m/s^2`], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(375, 50, [`v: ${sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2)} m/s`, `a: ${sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1)} m/s^2`], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. Both then fall together from rest.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball, complete with velocity and acceleration vectors, readouts, and an apex release gate.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
